title: Nimbus Travel & Expense Policy
subtitle: Employee business travel and reimbursement standard
principle: Spend responsibly, obtain approval before booking, and submit complete claims promptly.

sections.title: Purpose and scope
paragraphs: This policy applies to Nimbus employees travelling for approved company business. Contractors may claim travel costs only when their written agreement explicitly allows reimbursement.
Nimbus reimburses reasonable and necessary business expenses supported by this policy. Personal costs are the traveller's responsibility.

sections.title: Approval before travel
bullets: All international travel requires written manager approval before any booking is made.
Domestic travel with an estimated total cost above S$1,500 requires written manager approval before booking.
Approval requests should be submitted at least 5 business days before departure.
Retroactive approval is not permitted except for documented emergencies covered by Section 7.

sections.title: Accommodation limits
paragraphs: The nightly limits below cover the room rate only. Taxes and mandatory hotel fees may be claimed separately when supported by the hotel invoice.
bullets: A major international city is a destination listed as high-cost by Finance at the time of booking.
A room above the applicable limit requires written approval from both the traveller's manager and Finance before booking.

sections.title: Meals and incidentals
bullets: The daily maximum includes meals, non-alcoholic drinks, and reasonable gratuities.
Alcohol is not reimbursable.
Meals provided by a conference, hotel, airline, or host may not be claimed again.

sections.title: Transportation
bullets: Air and rail travel must use economy class and the lowest logical fare that meets the approved itinerary.
Use of a personal vehicle is reimbursed at S$0.70 per business kilometre.
Fuel may not be claimed separately when personal-vehicle mileage is reimbursed.
Public transport, taxis, and ride-hailing services are reimbursable at actual cost when used for a reasonable business route.

sections.title: Receipts and claim deadlines
bullets: An itemised receipt is required for any single expense above S$25 or the equivalent in another currency.
An expense claim must be submitted within 10 calendar days after the traveller's return date.
For example, a traveller who returns on 10 August 2026 must submit the claim by 20 August 2026.
Foreign-currency claims must use the card provider's posted conversion or the Finance exchange rate for the transaction date.

sections.title: Exceptions and emergencies
bullets: A planned exception requires written approval from both the traveller's manager and Finance before the expense is incurred.
For an unplanned safety or medical emergency, the traveller must notify their manager within 24 hours when reasonably possible.
Emergency claims must include an explanation and available supporting evidence. Finance may reject unsupported amounts.

sections.title: Non-reimbursable costs and assistance
bullets: Personal upgrades, minibar purchases, traffic or parking fines, companion travel, childcare, and lost personal property are not reimbursable.
Questions should be sent to travel@nimbus.example before booking or submitting a claim.
If local law conflicts with this policy, local law applies and Finance must review the claim.
